• Brand introduction:

Introducing Lluvido Store, Your One-Stop Shop for All Your Lifestyle Needs!

Discover a world of endless possibilities at Lluvido Store, where fashion meets functionality, and style meets substance. Our vast online store offers an incredible range of products, including:

Fashion, beauty, and accessories for men, women and kids.
Home and kitchen tools to make your life easier.
Fitness gear and equipment to help you reach your goals.
Baby and maternity products for expecting mothers and little ones.
Shoes, bags, and jewelries to elevate your style.
Electronics accessories and car accessories to upgrade your tech and ride.

What sets us apart:

- Huge selection: With thousands of products to choose from, you'll find everything you need in one convenient place.
- Competitive prices: We offer unbeatable prices without compromising on quality, so you can enjoy the best deals without breaking the bank.
- Free shipping on orders $58+: Get free shipping on all orders over $58, so you can shop with confidence and convenience.
- Quality guarantee: We stand behind the quality of our products and offer a satisfaction guarantee, so you can trust your purchases.

Join the Lluvido Store community today and experience the ultimate online shopping destination!


• USP (Unique Selling Point): 

Huge Product Selection: With a vast collection of products across various categories, including fashion, beauty, home and kitchen tools, fitness, baby and maternity, shoes, bags, jewelries, electronics accessories, and car accessories, customers can find everything they need in one convenient place.

Free Shipping on Orders $58+: Customers can enjoy free shipping on all orders over $58, making it even more convenient to shop with us.

Regular Discounts and Promotions: We regularly offer exclusive discounts and promotions to our customers, helping them save even more money on their purchases.

Loyalty Program: We have a loyalty program in place to reward our repeat customers, providing them with exclusive benefits and discounts.

Secure Payment Processing: Our website uses secure payment processing to protect customers' sensitive information and ensure a safe shopping experience.

User-Friendly Website: Our website is designed to provide a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience, with easy navigation, clear product descriptions, and high-quality product images.


• Payment terms:

Payment Terms for Affiliates

Payment Method:
- Payments will be made via debit card (Visa, Mastercard, or Maestro).
- Affiliates are responsible for ensuring their debit card information is accurate and up-to-date.

Payment Schedule:
- Payments will be made on a monthly basis, around the 30th of each month.
- Payments will be made for commissions earned from the 1st to the 30th of a particular month.

Tax Compliance:
- Affiliates are responsible for reporting their earnings and paying any applicable taxes.
- Lluvido Store can provide affiliates with a yearly earnings statement for tax purposes.

Payment Disputes:
- Any payment disputes must be reported to Lluvido Store within 30 days of the payment date.
- Lluvido Store will investigate and resolve payment disputes in a fair and timely manner.

By participating in the Lluvido Store affiliate program, affiliates acknowledge that they have read, understand, and agree to these payment terms.
